summary: Describes an optional IPv6 Router Advertisement extension for sending default router preferences and more-specific routes to hosts. It helps multi-homed hosts pick an appropriate router when routers are on different links. It is a standards-track document.

eli5.summary: If a house has two exits, one for the highway and one for the park, a sign tells you which door to use. This memo lets routers tell computers which exit is best for where they are going.
